_comment: Live relay config for the Madness Crew Discord.
Safe to commit: guild, channel and application IDs are not secrets.
The bot token is NOT here — it comes from the DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
environment variable, set as a repository secret in GitHub Actions.
Bot application ID 1536421123133022318, recorded here only so the
invite URL can be rebuilt if the bot ever needs re-adding:
_records_note: The channel launchers post lap records to. Create a dedicated one, make
a webhook on it, and put that webhook URL in records_webhook below.
The bot needs to read the channel; the launcher only ever writes to it.
Deleting a bogus message removes it from the board on the next run and
the next-fastest time takes the slot back.
_prune_note: With this on, the relay deletes a board message once every record in it
has been beaten by a faster run on the same race, difficulty and car by
the same driver. It keeps the channel the same shape as the board.
Deleting cannot be undone, so it is opt-in.
_speedrun_note: One block per game. board_game is the launcher's id for it.
MM1's categories are Amateur and Professional, matching the game's own
two difficulty tables. MM2's are race-setting rules rather than
difficulties, so its records carry the category name as their
difficulty instead of being passed off as amateur or pro times.
MM2 levels are named '<City> <Kind>: <Race>', and the city is split off
because each city numbers its races from zero.

_skip_why: Crash Course: not in the game's record tables at all — the other
three types fill all 320 slots, so no launcher can place them.
Circuit: the game records each LAP as its own entry, proven by
driving two laps and getting two records. speedrun.com times the
whole race, so the two measure different things and ranking them
together showed casual laps beating verified world records.

_comment: Only uploads whose TITLE matches one of these reaches the Videos tab.
not 'mm2020'. Exclusions are checked first and reject outright.
Add a term here and the next run picks it up — no launcher rebuild.
A channel that only ever posts about these games can skip the check
entirely with "filter": false on its own entry above.
_typos: 'midtown madnes' catches a real upload whose title is misspelled.
Typos cannot be predicted, only noticed: every rejected title is
printed in the workflow log, so scan it occasionally and add any
